tspu_architecture_peer_reviewed_control.source: Censored Planet / IMC 2022: TSPU: Russia's Decentralized Censorship System
findings_relevant_to_this_investigation: TSPU is deployed in-path across many Russian ISP networks while policy can be centrally controlled.
Measured triggers include SNI-based, IP-based and QUIC-based mechanisms.
Measured outcomes include RST modification, selective packet dropping and throttling rather than only total connectivity loss.
Behavior is asymmetric: Russian-originating connections can trigger interference while outside-originating controls may remain normal.
Devices are often close to end users, so geographically or ISP-scoped partial failure is technically plausible.
tspu_architecture_peer_reviewed_control.interpretation_boundary: These capabilities establish plausibility of selective/staggered Russian client-path disruption. They do not establish that the 2026-08-26 DNS change was malicious probing or that TSPU caused GitHub/OpenAI provider-side incidents.

tspu_throttling_historical_control.source: Censored Planet / IMC 2021 Twitter throttling study
findings_relevant_to_this_investigation: Traffic policing could be triggered by TLS SNI and selectively drop packets after a rate threshold.
The same target behavior was observed across multiple Russian fixed and mobile ISPs.
Collateral effects from relaxed matching rules were experimentally observed.
Different filtering components can be separately administered, so not every failure surface needs to appear simultaneously.

reported_signature: UDP DNS toward 8.8.8.8 and 1.1.1.1 returned selected NXDOMAIN responses.
Equivalent DNS over TCP could reach the original public resolver in the reported experiment.
Low-TTL probing exposed 195.208.5.1 in an ICMP TTL Exceeded response despite an original destination of 8.8.8.8.
Arbitrary UDP was reported not to undergo the same destination substitution, suggesting protocol-aware handling.

historical_telegram_2018_control.finding: Roskomnadzor blocked very large AWS/Google address ranges while attempting to block Telegram, causing collateral failures in unrelated services.
historical_telegram_2018_control.boundary: This event predates the 2019 legal basis and subsequent pervasive TSPU deployment. It demonstrates collateral-damage precedent, not technical identity with modern TSPU operation.

cross_layer_discriminator.current_result: The layers can coexist in the same time window without sharing a cause. JANUS C28 S3 remains most directly explained by GitHub's provider-side trigger/control-plane degradation unless a bridge between these layers is found.
